issue.title: just check fails at lint (symvision): 5 unused public symbols in axe desired_state/lifecycle_journal and bead-touches widget
issue.description: Found while splitting src/sase/ace/tui/actions/agents/_notification_utils.py. After the split's private-import errors were fixed, just _lint-symvision fails with Unused public functions/classes for 5 symbols in files untouched by the split: AxeDesiredState in src/sase/axe/desired_state.py; bead_touch_glyph and ordered_bead_verb_chips in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_bead_touches.py; lifecycle_journal_path and read_recent_successful_starts in src/sase/axe/lifecycle_journal.py. Fix per sase memory read symvision.md: make each private if only used in its own file (test-only references do not count), delete if dead, no pragmas.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic static linter failure, not intermittent: symvision reports the same 5 unused-public symbols on every run. The flagged files are byte-identical to HEAD (only the notification-split files differ in the tree), and the split added no references to these symbols, so the failure is independent of the in-progress split work.

payload.description: Same symvision masking pattern: fixing private-import errors surfaced these unused-public findings; different symbols and files than sase-13s

payload.entry: Partial resolution (sase-11y.10.1.3.1 land agent, 2026-09-21): the three axe symbols were caused by sase-11y.10.1.3.1.1 (0806937467 deleted their only non-test consumers ensure.py/_ensure_runtime.py) and are fixed in the epic's landing commit: AxeDesiredState -> _AxeDesiredState, lifecycle_journal_path -> _lifecycle_journal_path, read_recent_successful_starts deleted with its test assertion. just _lint-symvision now reports only bead_touch_glyph and ordered_bead_verb_chips (_agent_bead_touches.py), which trace to active epic sase-14j (2b3b37e89, sase-14j.5) and are already recorded there as a DISCOVERED ISSUE (sase-14j note #2).

evidence.note: Independent reproduction in workspace sase_10 at master 42acc2979 with an unrelated diff (Agents-tilde-neighbor removal: modal deletion plus badge/footer/command-scope edits). just _lint-symvision fails with byte-identical findings for the same 5 symbols (AxeDesiredState, bead_touch_glyph, ordered_bead_verb_chips, lifecycle_journal_path, read_recent_successful_starts); none of the removed imports reference those modules, and their defining files are untouched by this diff, so the gate is red independent of this work.
